PLAN (acto-builder, #258 doc-drift tripwire): Ship the gate + oracle fixture tests + make targets + self-route, manifest = {tooling/doc-drift.py (NEW), tooling/tests/test_doc_drift.py (NEW), Makefile (EDIT), tooling/spec-routes.toml (EDIT)}. tooling/doc-drift.py: stdlib-only python3, tomllib route load, doc->files inversion, ^audited-sha:\s*([0-9a-f]{40})\b pin extraction, pin validation (rev-parse --verify ^{commit} + merge-base --is-ancestor), commit-set drift predicate (git log --format=%H

..HEAD -- pathspec; :(glob) for patterns), DRIFT/MISSING-PIN/INVALID-PIN/CURRENT classes, deterministic doc-then-file sort, exit 0/1/3 (3=env: git/repo/tomllib/routes absent, never traceback/fail-open), --root flag defaulting to git toplevel. Tests: unittest fixtures building throwaway git repos per oracle O-1..O-8. Makefile: doc-drift + doc-drift-test .PHONY targets. Route: REQ-11 declarative block. Gauntlet: oracle tests, live-tree run (expect exit 1, 48 MISSING-PIN), make doc-drift, git diff scripts/audit.sh empty, cargo build sanity, sibling-intact. NOT in scope: 48-doc bootstrap pin sweep, scripts/audit.sh (byte-identical), CI workflow, the design doc itself (untracked, not on manifest).
